overview: Pillagers have taken to the sea. Out on open water there are ships now: whole, afloat and crewed, with the plunder still in their chests.

1.0.0: Four crewed ships sail the open water: sloop, longship, brigantine and galleon, built the way the vanilla shipwrecks are, two woods and flared hulls and log masts, but these never sank.
Each is drawn from its own seed, so no two are quite alike.
